label: Everything the Guide Me Builder says from the server (every problem a script can have)

params.name: not_script
params.default: That is not a whole Guide Me script. Check that the file or the pasted text runs from its first line to its last.

params.name: too_big
params.default: The script is larger than {kb} KB. Shorten its narration or split the tour in two.

params.name: has_problems
params.default: {n} {n:thing|things} to fix before this Guide Me can be created.

description_nl: Plain sentences only - a person fixing a tour never reads a code word. The script's own rules and their sentences are chips guide.check + guide.messages (core); these are the Builder's own: a text that is not a script, one too large, the count, and what happened to a build.

expect_value.not_script: That is not a whole Guide Me script. Check that the file or the pasted text runs from its first line to its last.
expect_value.too_big: The script is larger than {kb} KB. Shorten its narration or split the tour in two.
expect_value.has_problems: {n} {n:thing|things} to fix before this Guide Me can be created.
